title: Behold the Lamb of God
author: Jeffrey R. Holland
calling_raw: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
notes_text: 6.  See Bible Dictionary, “ Anointed One ”; see also Guide to the Scriptures, “ Anointed One ,” scriptures.ChurchofJesusChrist.org.

7.  Ironically, Cain’s slaying of Abel, an act ultimately directed by Satan, may have been linked to Cain’s earlier anger over his sacrificial offering being rejected by the Lord while Abel’s was accepted. “God … prepared a sacrifice in the gift of His own Son, who should … open a door through which man might enter into the Lord’s presence. … “By faith in this atonement or plan of redemption, Abel offered to God a sacrifice that was accepted, which was the firstlings of the flock. Cain offered of the fruit of the ground, and was not accepted. … [His sacrifice was to have included] the shedding of blood” ( Teachings of Presidents of the Church: Joseph Smith [2007], 48 ; see also 107–8 ).
